name: bld4_pisano_ten
informal: Uses Mathlib2.lib_pisano_dvd_iff_period, Mathlib2.lib_fib_period_iff and Mathlib2.bld3_pisano_dvd_pisano_of_dvd: lib_pisano_dvd_iff_period + lib_fib_period_iff reduce 'π(m) ∣ N' to the decidable check F_N ≡ 0, F_{N+1} ≡ 1 mod m; this gives π(10) ∣ 60, and identifies π(2) = 3 and π(5) = 20 (20 works, the divisors 4 and 10 fail). bld3_pisano_dvd_pisano_of_dvd then gives 3 ∣ π(10) and 20 ∣ π(10), so 60 ∣ π(10).
